home.title: Kuwait Villa Cost Calculator
home.subtitle: Estimate the cost of building your villa in Kuwait — a quick, transparent preliminary budget.
home.disclaimer: Preliminary estimate for planning purposes only. Not a contractor quotation.
home.exAlhisbaD: 400 m² plot · 2 floors · 640 m² · Grade C → 122,000 KWD (observation only)
home.demoNote: Default prices are published research/demo benchmarks — not Urban-approved rates.

property.title: Property information
property.investmentNote: Investment property is not yet supported by the rate library. Enter a manual rate in Specifications or choose Private villa.
property.plotHint: Plot (land) area is recorded but is never used as built-up area.
property.locationHint: Recorded for the report. Location does not change the price (no supported location coefficient).
property.siteNotesPh: e.g. corner plot, narrow access, special conditions…

floors.title: Building floors & areas
floors.sub: Enter the built-up area of each floor.
floors.rateOverrideHint: Leave blank to use the selected rate. Only enter if you have a documented floor-specific price.
floors.suggestNote: Experimental assumption: 80% coverage was inferred from ONE Alhisba result (400 m² plot, 2 floors → 640 m²). It is not a Kuwait Municipality regulation. Always check your design.
floors.apply: Apply to enabled ground / first / second floors
floors.roofNote: The roof annex is never auto-filled — enter its actual area.

basement.title: Basement
basement.question: Does your villa have a basement?
basement.pricingNote: A basement is priced separately. The above-ground rate is never reused for the basement.
basement.noLibrary: No basement rates in the rate library yet.
basement.includes: What does this basement price include?
basement.includesHint: Unticked items are listed as exclusions. Shoring/dewatering you need but haven't included are flagged as unpriced.
basement.unpricedNote: Basement cost not yet priced. The estimate will be shown as partial.

specs.title: Construction specifications
specs.manualHint: Low and high are optional — if blank they equal typical.
specs.noRate: No rate in the library for this scope and grade. Enter a manual rate or the result will be unpriced.
specs.otherSystem: Different grading system — not equivalent to Urban grades
specs.floorHeightHint: Recorded only. No calibrated height coefficient is applied.

extras.title: Optional additions, owner budget & fees
extras.additionsHint: Every item stays unpriced until you enter a rate and its source.
extras.included: Standard version already in baseline scope
extras.ownerDirectHint: Items you buy directly (not paid to the contractor). Counted once, outside construction.
extras.feesHint: All default to zero. Enter only what applies — none is assumed to be a mandatory Kuwait charge.

results.title: Estimated construction cost
results.partialBody: Some items are not yet priced. Totals below cover the priced items only and are not the full villa cost.
results.blockedBody: Resolve the following before an estimate can be produced:
results.notQuote: Preliminary estimate — not a contractor quotation.

breakdown.title: Cost breakdown
breakdown.tradeNote: Trade allocations (structure / MEP / finishing) are not shown: no trade-level pricing supports them for this estimate.

basis.net_additions: {count} priced item(s), net of included allowances

issues.RATE_RANGE_ORDER: Low ≤ typical ≤ high is required for the manual rate.
issues.INVESTMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED: Investment property has no rates in the library. Use a manual rate.

issues.RATE_GRADE_MISMATCH: Rate {rate} is for grade {rateGrade}, not the selected {grade}.
issues.RATE_OTHER_GRADE_SYSTEM: Rate {rate} uses another provider's grading ({rateGrade}); its specification is not equivalent to Urban grades.
issues.SCOPE_UNPRICED: No rate is available for {scope} / {grade}. Enter a manual rate.
issues.RATE_NOT_APPROVED: Rate {rate} is a {status} — not an Urban-approved rate.
issues.RATE_STALE: Rate {rate} dated {date} may be out of date.

issues.GROUNDWATER_UNKNOWN: Groundwater condition unknown — dewatering not priced.

issues.NEGATIVE_CONSTRUCTION: Credits exceed construction cost — check additions.

issues.HEIGHT_NOT_PRICED: Floor height is recorded but does not change the price.
issues.GROUND_EXCEEDS_PLOT: Ground floor area is larger than the plot — check you have not entered plot area as built-up area.
issues.ROOF_ANNEX_LARGE: Roof annex area looks too large — it is normally much smaller than a full floor.

unpriced.BASEMENT_UNPRICED: Basement ({area} m²) — no basement rate or allowance entered
unpriced.SHORING_UNPRICED: Basement shoring — required but not priced

report.title: Preliminary Construction Budget
report.printHint: Use your browser's print dialog and choose “Save as PDF”.
report.disclaimer: This is a preliminary planning estimate produced from area-based rates. It is not a contractor quotation, not a priced bill of quantities and not structural design. Final costs depend on approved drawings, site conditions, specifications and tendered prices. Rates marked as published benchmarks are third-party research data, not Urban Projects' approved prices.
report.a1: Built-up areas are as entered; plot area is not used as built-up area.
report.a2: Location and floor height are recorded only; no adjustment coefficient is applied.
report.a3: Each line is rounded to the nearest KWD; totals are exact sums of rounded lines.

saved.title: Saved estimates
saved.savedWith: Saved with ratebook v{saved}; current is v{current}. Recalculated figures may differ.

admin.title: Rate library
admin.sub: Version-controlled ratebook. Changes are stored in this browser only (local V1).
admin.localNote: Local administration: no login in this standalone version. Do not deploy publicly without authentication.
admin.resetConfirm: Replace the ratebook with the default research/demo rates?
admin.approvedWarn: Changing the price of an Urban-approved rate resets it to provisional unless you re-approve it.

research.title: Research benchmarks
research.sub: Observed and published data from other Kuwait calculators. Kept separate from Urban pricing — never used as Urban-approved rates.
research.alObsNote: Transcribed from user screenshots. Only AL-004 has fully confirmed inputs. This is not a clone of Alhisba's algorithm; A/B rates are not inferred.
research.matrixNote: Untested scenarios remain blank until real inputs and results are supplied.
research.coverageNote: Fits one observed case only. Not a regulation.
research.tqNote: Two observed Taqeem results. About nine inputs changed between them, so the 109,000 KWD difference is NOT a basement premium. Taqeem's pricing algorithm is not reproduced.
research.rtNote: Published rates as recorded in research, with source date and authority. Product-only prices are not installed prices.
research.observedOnly: Historical observation for this exact input combination — not a reproduced formula.
